bins: Use prepared-forecasts.parquet existing discretized columns, unchanged; no thresholds fitted or searched.
baseline: Same-fold branch factor; branch comparator included. scoreImprovement = 1 - candidate meanIntervalScore / branch meanIntervalScore.
fallback: Missing or unsupported branch×feature -> branch -> sector -> global; branch baseline -> sector -> global. No rows dropped per candidate.
weights: Reuse root pool_weights on whole same-fold calibration or evaluation pool; never rebalance within feature groups. Annual evaluation regenerates pool weights within target year.

splits.calibration: Prepared calibration_ok rows only, target FY<=2020 and original publication gates through2021-06-30

supports: Report support counts and eligible groups for parent and refinement; fallbackShare remains actual weighted parent-fallback share.
classification: Exploratory follow-up fixed before inspecting any within-branch outcome results; recent years already used elsewhere, so not untouched confirmation.
limitations: Current taxonomy and retrospective merged financial vintage; no point-in-time reconstruction.
TBV/EBIT is missing when strict5 denominator/book guards fail; such cases receive parent factors.
Branch×asset associations can be predictive without proving asset intensity causes uncertainty.
Five-year signed-cash normalization and share-class dependencies retain original experiment limitations.
